questions.question: Which mammal lays eggs instead of giving birth to live young?
questions.hint: The platypus is one of the few mammals that lay eggs and is native to Australia.

questions.question: Which tree is famous for storing large amounts of water in its trunk?
questions.hint: Baobab trees can store thousands of liters of water, helping them survive long dry seasons.

questions.question: Which wizard is Harry Potter's headmaster?
questions.hint: Professor Albus Dumbledore is the wise headmaster of Hogwarts.

questions.question: Which Pixar movie follows an elderly man who travels with his house attached to balloons?
questions.hint: Carl Fredricksen fulfills his dream of adventure by flying his house using balloons.

questions.question: What does 'WWW' stand for on the internet?
questions.hint: The World Wide Web is the system of web pages accessed through the internet.

questions.question: Which document officially records a person's birth?
questions.hint: A birth certificate is an official government record of a person's birth.

questions.question: Which ancient wonder was located in Alexandria, Egypt?
questions.hint: The Lighthouse of Alexandria was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

questions.question: Who painted the famous artwork 'Mona Lisa'?
questions.hint: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa during the Renaissance.

questions.question: In which sport is the Ryder Cup contested?
questions.hint: The Ryder Cup is a famous golf competition between Europe and the United States.

questions.question: How many rings are displayed on the Olympic flag?
questions.hint: The five rings represent the participation of athletes from the world's continents.

questions.question: Which is the deepest ocean on Earth?
questions.hint: The Mariana Trench, the deepest point on Earth, is located in the Pacific Ocean.

questions.question: Which capital city sits on the River Seine?
questions.hint: The River Seine flows through the heart of Paris.

questions.question: Which planet is the largest in our Solar System?
questions.hint: Jupiter is more than twice as massive as all the other planets combined.

questions.question: What is the smallest unit of ordinary matter?
questions.hint: Atoms are the basic building blocks of matter.

questions.question: Which country is famous for the traditional dance called the Hula?
questions.hint: The Hula is a traditional Hawaiian dance that tells stories through movement.

questions.question: Which country is famous for making Swiss watches?
questions.hint: Switzerland is renowned worldwide for precision watchmaking.

questions.question: Which is the tallest waterfall in the world?
questions.hint: Angel Falls in Venezuela drops nearly 1,000 meters (3,212 feet).

questions.question: Which country has the city of Cape Town?
questions.hint: Cape Town is one of South Africa's three capital cities.

questions.question: Which gas makes up most of the Sun?
questions.hint: The Sun is composed primarily of hydrogen, which fuses into helium to produce energy.

questions.question: Which wall came down in 1989, symbolizing the end of the Cold War?
questions.hint: The fall of the Berlin Wall marked a major turning point in European history and the end of the Cold War.
